Senate Returns Amid Uncertainty Over Mitch McConnell's Health

The U.S. Senate is scheduled to reconvene on Monday, with significant uncertainty surrounding the return and health of Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell. McConnell, the longest-serving Senate party leader in history, has experienced recent public health incidents, including freezing spells during public appearances. His ability to continue leading the Republican caucus is a subject of discussion among his colleagues and in media coverage. The Senate's agenda for the upcoming session remains unclear, partly due to these concerns about McConnell's condition.
